---
title: "Getting started"
---

This page covers the one-time setup you need before preparing datasets for the Bigger Picture project.

## What you need access to

- **Asana** — to select and track which dataset you are working on.
- **The shared OneDrive folder** — the raw data lives in *Bigger Picture – DOE Grant – Documents → IPD Component → datasets*.
  Each dataset sits in a folder named `BPIPD-<id> - <name>` (for example `BPIPD-9999 - Example Cohort Study`).
- **GitHub** — you need to be a member of the [Motivation-and-Behaviour](https://github.com/Motivation-and-Behaviour) organisation to push branches and open pull requests.

## Install the tools

1. **R and RStudio** — install both from [posit.co/download](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
2. **GitHub Desktop** — install from [desktop.github.com](https://desktop.github.com/), sign in, and clone the `Motivation-and-Behaviour/bigger_picture` repository.
3. **R packages** — open the repository in RStudio (GitHub Desktop → *Repository → Open in RStudio*) and run this in the Console:

   ```r
   install.packages("pak")
   pak::local_install_dev_deps()
   ```

   This installs everything listed in the repository's `DESCRIPTION` file, so there is no package list to keep up to date by hand.

::: {.callout-note}
## Developers: devcontainer

If you are working on the pipeline itself (rather than preparing datasets), the repository includes a devcontainer (`.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`) that ships with all packages installed and mounts the data directory automatically.
The rest of this page assumes the plain RStudio setup used for dataset preparation.
:::

## Point the pipeline at the data

The pipeline discovers datasets in the directory named by the `DATASET_PATH` environment variable, which it reads from a `.env` file at the repository root.
Create a file called `.env` (it is gitignored, so it never ends up in a commit) containing the path to your synced OneDrive datasets folder, for example:

```sh
DATASET_PATH="C:/Users/you/OneDrive/.../IPD Component/datasets"
```

To check it works, run this from the repository in RStudio:

```r
targets::tar_source()
list_datasets()
```

You should see one row per `BPIPD-*` folder in the datasets directory.
If the path is wrong you will get an error saying `DATASET_PATH` is not set, or an empty result.

## Next step

You are ready to prepare a dataset — continue with [Adding a dataset](adding-a-dataset.qmd).
